maddeler.e:
أستشرق (form X)
# أَسْتَشْرِقُ (ʔastašriqu) /ʔas.taʃ.ri.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشْرَقَ (istašraqa)
# أَسْتَشْرِقَ (ʔastašriqa) /ʔas.taʃ.ri.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَشْرَقَ (istašraqa)
# أَسْتَشْرِقْ (ʔastašriq) /ʔas.taʃ.riq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَشْرَقَ (istašraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
